result.stdout:
Description:
  Validate and render deterministic dialect-specific SQL.

Usage:
  DubUrl.Cli schema render <input> [options]

Arguments:
  <input>  Schema document path, or '-' for standard input.

Options:
  --input-format <input-format>    Input format for standard input or an extensionless file: yaml or json.
  --output-format <output-format>  Output format: human (default) or json.
  --dialect <dialect> (REQUIRED)   SQL dialect (for example pgsql, mssql, or sqlite).
  --output <output>                Write SQL to this file instead of standard output.
  --drop-existing                  Render explicit drop-if-exists statements before creation.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  Validate, render, and execute a schema through the application service.

Usage:
  DubUrl.Cli schema deploy <input> [options]

Arguments:
  <input>  Schema document path, or '-' for standard input.

Options:
  --input-format <input-format>      Input format for standard input or an extensionless file: yaml or json.
  --output-format <output-format>    Output format: human (default) or json.
  --connection <connection>          Named connection from configuration.
  --connection-env <connection-env>  Name of an environment variable containing the connection URL.
  --dry-run                          Print the exact SQL without opening a connection.
  --drop-existing                    Drop existing objects before creation.
  --yes                              Confirm destructive deployment in non-interactive use.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information
